MOSAIC organizes degraded observations into structural slots that capture complementary object-level and layout-level evidence, integrates them across resolutions, and retrieves recurring priors from a shared prototype memory to complement incomplete image-specific information. The resulting representations are injected into selected layers of a frozen diffusion Transformer through lightweight residual modulation, preserving its pretrained generative prior. We instantiate MOSAIC for remote sensing image super-resolution, where small objects, repetitive structures, and large-scale variation provide a challenging testbed. Experiments on UCMerced, AID, and RSSCN7 show consistent PSNR improvements across $\times 2$ and $\times 4$ settings and favorable LPIPS results at $\times 4$. Qualitative results further demonstrate improved preservation of small objects, structural boundaries, and repetitive spatial patterns.

items.title_en: Efficient Confidence-Aware Densification for 3DGS
items.abstract_en: 3DGS-MCMC has replaced the gradient-driven density control of 3D Gaussian Splatting with opacity-based sampling and relocation, and is now the de facto standard for prior-free densification under a fixed primitive budget. Because opacity stays high where the scene is already well reconstructed, this sampling sends most new primitives to the foreground and leaves the background under-reconstructed. At low budgets, prior-based methods such as ConeGS and EDGS outperform it, at the cost of a pre-trained radiance field or dense image matches and a separate initialization stage. We argue for a comeback of error-driven densification within the fixed-budget MCMC framework. Our confidence-aware densification keeps the fixed budget and gradual growth of 3DGS-MCMC, but places primitives by the image error instead of the opacity. New primitives are drawn mostly where screen-space gradients are large. We favor primitives with a low learned confidence, which marks regions the reconstruction still explains poorly, and relocate the primitives that contribute least to the rendered images to these places. Averaged over 24 scenes, our method outperforms 3DGS-MCMC in PSNR, SSIM and LPIPS at every budget from 100k to 2M primitives. At 100k, without a prior or an initialization stage, it recovers 0.84dB of the 1.05dB PSNR by which ConeGS leads 3DGS-MCMC, and from 500k on, it has the highest PSNR and SSIM of all fixed-budget methods we compare with, including ConeGS and EDGS. While inherently prior-free, our densification can also exploit priors: from the ConeGS or EDGS initialization, it matches ConeGS in PSNR and SSIM at 100k and is best in all three metrics at 500k.

items.title_en: Knowing Whether, Not Just Where: Anchor-Probing Distillation for Open-Set Remote Sensing Visual Grounding
items.abstract_en: Open-set visual grounding in remote sensing requires models to determine not only where a queried object is located, but also whether the image provides sufficient evidence for the query at all. Existing closed-set grounding models, however, tend to return plausible boxes even for absent objects, blurring localization confidence with genuine Visual Support. We introduce AnchorProbe-Distill (APD), a teacher-student framework that recasts open-set grounding as Visual Support learning. APD builds on the insight that supported queries should induce coherent spatial anchors, whereas unsupported or mismatched queries tend to produce unstable or misleading localization patterns. APD-T therefore uses the Original Query as a Reference Anchor to interpret query perturbations: Semantic-Preserving Queries retain the annotated target, Near-Category Ambiguous Queries are resolved according to whether they form a reliable alternative anchor or collapse onto the Reference Anchor, and Far-Category Counterfactual Queries provide rejection supervision. This reference-aware reasoning is distilled into APD-S, enabling unified localization and rejection from a single image--query pair. Experiments show that APD enables the resulting model to reject absent targets while also improving its localization of present targets.

items.title_en: Beyond Successful Robot Demonstrations: Learning from Human Interactions and Modeling Failure Dynamics
items.abstract_en: Action-conditioned world models offer a promising foundation for generalist robotic intelligence by predicting the consequences of actions. However, existing robotic datasets provide limited coverage of the diverse interaction dynamics required for generalizable world modeling. Large-scale egocentric human videos offer complementary interaction experience, yet the embodiment gap between human hands and robotic manipulators hinders effective cross-embodiment learning. Meanwhile, the predominance of successful demonstrations leaves failure dynamics substantially underrepresented, limiting the ability of world models to anticipate unsuccessful executions. To address these limitations, we introduce HF-WM, an action-conditioned world model that combines Human interaction learning with Failure-aware post-training. To bridge the embodiment gap, we develop a dual-branch framework that couples video generation with auxiliary pointflow prediction, using stabilized pointflow as a unified motion representation across human and robot interactions while suppressing egocentric camera motion. To improve failure modeling, we further perform Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) post-training on perturbed actions derived from successful demonstrations, guided by action alignment and physical plausibility rewards, enabling the model to learn plausible failure dynamics without paired ground-truth videos. Extensive experiments demonstrate that HF-WM achieves state-of-the-art performance in action-conditioned video generation and exhibits strong utility for policy evaluation in downstream robotic tasks.

items.title_en: SplatQ: Interaction-Aware Pruning of 3D Gaussian Splatting via Quadratic Selection
items.abstract_en: Existing 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) pruning methods primarily rely on global Top-K selection based on independent importance scores, lacking regional budget control and ignoring joint deletion effects. Consequently, they cannot ensure balanced reconstruction quality across a scene. We propose SplatQ, a combinatorial pruning algorithm that coordinates regional budget allocation and joint Gaussian selection under a fixed budget. SplatQ partitions Gaussians by spatial proximity and appearance similarity into size-limited blocks, decomposing global selection into subproblems of a specific size. It then smooths importance-based block retention quotas to prevent excessive budget concentration. Finally, it constructs a quadratic approximation of joint deletion effects using the responses of representative pixel colors to changes in Gaussian opacity. Individual responses, pairwise interactions, and quota penalties are incorporated into a quadratic unconstrained binary optimization (QUBO) objective, solved using simulated annealing (SA) or a coherent Ising machine (CIM) to jointly select Gaussians. Experiments on 5 benchmarks demonstrate that SplatQ outperforms state-of-the-art pruning methods in aggregate reconstruction quality, spatial quality balance, and rendering speed. Ablations confirm that budget smoothing improves local detail reconstruction, while interaction modeling improves Gaussian selection quality under a fixed budget.

items.title_en: Stride: Scale-Aware Multi-Agent Evolutionary Refinement for Infographic Generation
items.abstract_en: Infographic generation challenges text-to-image models because a single image must satisfy numerous visual, textual, and semantic constraints. Iterative agentic refinement with a multimodal verifier is a natural remedy, but existing methods face a scale mismatch: local edits cannot correct global composition errors, while full regeneration may destroy already-correct regions. We introduce Stride, a constraint-grounded multi-agent framework that treats refinement over any frozen generator as a history-aware evolution strategy. Stride separates constraint evaluation - whether each requirement is satisfied - from visual grounding - where and how it is violated. It then routes global revisions to a composer subagent and local corrections to a retoucher subagent. Each subagent conducts internal planning and generates multiple candidates, while Stride accepts a candidate only when it improves the verifier score, reducing regression across iterations. Because stochastic generators and imperfect verifiers make any single step unreliable, it is this combination of scale-aware routing, per-step redundancy, and monotonic acceptance that yields stable improvement across iterations. With fully open-weight generator-verifier systems, Stride outperforms proprietary systems including Nano-Banana-2.0 and Seedream-5.0-Pro on BizGenEval, matches GPT-Image-2.0 and surpasses Seedream-5.0-Pro on IGenBench, and achieves a new state-of-the-art score on WISE, while substantially outperforming existing agentic methods across all evaluated benchmarks.

items.title_en: A Hybrid and Hierarchical Ray Tracing Method for Efficient 3D Gaussian Rendering
items.abstract_en: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) is a powerful representation for real-time neural reconstruction and rendering. While existing 3DGS systems rely on rasterization for efficiency, recent work explores ray tracing to enable secondary lighting, highly distorted cameras, and depth-of-field effects. However, compared with rasterization, ray-traced 3DGS introduces three major challenges: (1) the highly non-uniform spatial distribution of massive numbers of Gaussian primitives creates severe load imbalance; (2) neighboring pixels often generate rays with highly similar traversal paths, leading to substantial redundant traversal overhead; and (3) supporting both Gaussian and triangle primitives yields heterogeneous intersection workloads that are not well matched to existing GPU architectures. We present H2-Ray, a hybrid and hierarchical ray tracing architecture for efficient 3D Gaussian rendering. H2-Ray introduces three techniques. Load-Balanced Spatial BVH (LB-SBVH) partitions the scene into uniform grids and uses density-aware representations to convert an imbalanced global workload into balanced local traversal units. Ray-Cluster Path Reuse (RCPR) lets a proxy ray share traversal state with neighboring rays to amortize redundant traversal. The Unified Intersection Engine (UIE) supports mixed Gaussian and triangle intersections through a mode-multiplexed datapath that shares 40% of its floating-point units across both primitive types. Across 8 scenes, H2-Ray achieves a geometric-mean speedup of 3.77x and a maximum speedup of 9.26x over RaySplats on the NVIDIA RTX A5000, combining a cycle-accurate model of the modified RT Core with measured CUDA timings.

items.title_en: Hierarchical Graph Neural Network for Probabilistic Power Flow with Grid Topology Contingencies
items.abstract_en: Data-driven surrogates reduce the nonlinear solves required for probabilistic power flow (PPF), but models tied to a fixed bus--branch graph often generalize poorly when outages change electrical coupling. This paper proposes a topology-decomposition-driven hierarchical bidirectional graph neural network (TDD--HBGNN) for PPF under unseen topologies. For each realized topology, the network is decomposed into fundamental topological units (FTUs), dynamically homogeneous voltage clusters (DHVCs), and a core backbone sub-grid (CBSG), with equivalent-admittance representations preserving electrical ports between units. A sensitivity-based linear prior captures the first-order voltage-magnitude and phase-angle response, while the HBGNN learns topology-dependent nonlinear residuals. Impedance- and uncertainty-aware bottom-up aggregation condenses local perturbations, while mode-modulated top-down broadcasting restores system context at buses. We evaluate our approach on the IEEE 118-bus and Polish 2746-bus systems under unseen N--1 and N--2 contingencies against six baseline methods. Compared with these methods, TDD--HBGNN achieves 2.47--4.20-fold lower all-bus phase-angle errors and lower phase-angle errors in every held-out event. Its voltage-magnitude advantage is concentrated near the outaged branches, where paired error ratios reach 1.75--2.58 on the IEEE system and 1.87--1.97 in Polish N--2 events. All system--contingency--baseline comparisons favor TDD--HBGNN in joint voltage--angle error. Moreover, shared hierarchical operators keep the model size at 0.658 million parameters across both grids and yield 0.161--1.793~ms forward latency per probabilistic case. These results demonstrate system-wide angular accuracy, outage-local voltage accuracy, and parameter-efficient scaling across unseen topologies.

items.title_en: GraftOOD: Grafting Out-of-Distribution Exemplars into Advantage-Weighted Rectification for Video Reward Optimization
items.abstract_en: Video reward optimization can increase proxy rewards while reducing video dynamics, a mismatch we identify as \emph{motion collapse}, including under a video-level motion-quality reward. We propose \textbf{GraftOOD}, which replaces part of the online rollouts in selected prompt groups with out-of-distribution video exemplars. A shared velocity-regression objective combines group-relative reward rectification with sequence-level exemplar supervision, requiring neither exemplar generation trajectories nor an additional supervised-loss coefficient. We characterize its pointwise optimal field as a source-posterior-weighted combination of the two source-specific target fields. We construct \textbf{GraftSet-Video}, containing 9,588 format-matched exemplars for 2,397 prompts, to supply external supervision. On Wan2.1-1.3B, GraftOOD raises Dynamic Degree from 4.86 to 44.41 relative to reward-only FlowAWR, while HPSv3 decreases from 8.10 to 7.32 and VisionReward remains close. At the main setting, GraftOOD leads nine of ten metrics among three exemplar-augmented methods. Ablations of exemplar frequency and within-group count reveal dynamics--reward trade-offs rather than uniform gains from increasing exemplar usage. These results support external exemplar supervision as a complement to scalar reward feedback, without equating higher measured dynamics with coherent, visually plausible motion in the generated videos. Code is available at \href{https://github.com/Fuzm7/FlowAWR}{GraftOOD}.

items.title_en: A Real-World CAD Segmentation Benchmark: Comparing Rule-Based and Learning-Based Approaches through Hole Detection
items.abstract_en: CAD segmentation datasets are predominantly synthetic or automatically labelled, leaving it unclear how well existing methods transfer to real-world engineering tasks. Fastener-relevant hole detection represents one such task, requiring human annotation and exhibiting greater geometric complexity than commonly used benchmarks. We address this gap through three main contributions. First, we develop two task-specific rule-based methods, one graph-wire-search and one multi-view based, and complement them with a human-annotated benchmark dataset derived from engineering CAD data that also enables training of UV-Net and AAGNet, representative learning-based approaches for B-Rep segmentation. Second, we conduct an extensive experimental study including parameter optimisation, evaluation on our benchmark dataset, cross-domain generalisation on a synthetic dataset, and an assessment of the feasibility of the approaches at varying dataset sizes and IoU thresholds. Third, we provide evidence-based insights into the strengths and limitations of different approaches: rule-based methods generalise well without training data, with the graph-wire-search method favouring recall and the multi-view method favouring precision, whereas learning-based methods achieve strong performance with sufficient annotations but exhibit reduced robustness under domain shift. These findings highlight trade-offs between data requirements, and robustness, and provide guidance not only for hole detection, but more broadly for real-world CAD segmentation tasks.

items.title_en: When MLLMs miss what humans read: diagnosing and learning to read squint text
items.abstract_en: Multimodal LLMs can fail to read text embedded in an image's coarse structure (text a human recovers by squinting) and report that no text is present. We name this class Squint Text and study it as a recognition deficiency, motivated by cases from a production moderation pipeline. We introduce SquintBench, comprising 1076 production-derived moderation images, and SquintCtrl, a controlled synthetic suite for mechanism diagnosis. Frozen-weight analysis shows that hidden text leaves a coarse signal while glyph identity is weakly represented; identity becomes substantially more accessible when the correct spatial regions are supplied, implicating spatial selection as a major bottleneck. Suppressing high-frequency content also improves reading at a fixed visual-token budget, while visual token count may also contribute. These findings motivate Squint OPSD: a frozen teacher receives a downscaled view and the ground-truth transcription as privileged context, and its token-level distributions supervise a student along on-policy trajectories. At inference, the student reads the original image alone. Squint OPSD reaches 88.61 ANLS on SquintBench, versus 26.50 for the unadapted backbone, 24.44 for the best general-purpose model on the original view, and 68.60 at best for an off-the-shelf model under a downscaled view. These results substantially narrow the gap between available visual evidence and its generated read-out without auxiliary views at inference.

items.title_en: SADL: A Size-Adaptive Decision Layer for Chronic Stroke Lesion Segmentation in ISLES 2026
items.abstract_en: Chronic ischemic stroke lesions are difficult to segment on T1-weighted MRI. Their appearance overlaps with healthy tissue, and their volumes span four orders of magnitude, so voxel-level and lesion level metrics often disagree. We build an eleven-member nnU-Net ensemble that covers five design axes: a baseline dice + top-K loss, heavy augmentation, per-lesion volume loss re-weighting, stochastic weight averaging, and a sampling-and-architecture block that pairs cohort-balanced sampling with a residual-encoder backbone. Weighted soft-map fusion of the members feeds a tuned decision layer, SADL, that estimates lesion volume, applies an adaptive per-lesion-size threshold, prunes components by voxel count and peak probability, and adds a never-empty rescue. All fusion weights and per-bucket parameters are fitted on out-of-fold (OOF) predictions, so tuning never touches the held-out test set. On a site-disjoint 91-case holdout, SADL reaches Dice 0.7322, lesion-F1 0.7461 and PR-AUC 0.8430 when scored online with the challenge's released evaluation code. A paired non-parametric bootstrap against a reference single ensemble member confirms the lesion-F1 gain at p=0.024, and the gain is largest in the small-lesion regime, where the rescue step recovers cases that a fixed threshold would silently discard.

items.title_en: TextVBench: Evaluating Text Rendering and Preservation in Video Generation
items.abstract_en: Modern video generators can synthesize convincing scenes while rendering a few characters incorrectly, omitting requested text, or changing it across frames. Measuring these failures is harder than applying OCR independently to each frame: when a scene contains multiple text targets and multiple noisy OCR regions, the evaluator must first determine which observation belongs to which intended text. We introduce TextVBench, a benchmark and evaluation framework that formulates visual-text evaluation as a multi-target, multi-instance spatiotemporal correspondence problem. TextVBench contains two complementary tracks: TextVBench-T2V measures the creation and maintenance of prompt-specified text, while TextVBench-Ref2V measures preservation of text from reference images. Both tracks use target-conditioned candidate selection rather than unconstrained VLM transcription, support one target mapping to multiple OCR regions, and separate frame-level spatial fidelity from cross-frame temporal fidelity. A length-weighted harmonic score summarizes these factors, while extra-text diagnostics expose failure modes hidden by a single OCR score. The benchmark is organized around controlled text, layout, carrier, and motion attributes so that aggregate scores can be traced back to specific capability limits. Across the evaluated model runs, MiniMax-H3 reaches a T2V TextVScore of 68.32, while the strongest Ref2V score is 56.51; attribute slices reveal a pronounced drop as the number of simultaneous reference text regions increases.

items.title_en: Radiomics-Based Thyroid Nodule Classification with Label-Conditional Conformal Prediction
items.title_zh: 基于放射组学的甲状腺结节分类与标签条件共形预测
items.abstract_en: Thyroid nodule malignancy assessment relies on ultrasound imaging, yet current risk stratification systems suffer from substantial interobserver variability, contributing to a high rate of unnecessary biopsies. We propose a radiomics-based framework combining quantitative feature extraction via PyRadiomics with a Generalized Additive Model (GAM) classifier, selected among six candidates for its favorable trade-off between discriminative performance and interpretability. To complement point predictions with uncertainty estimates, Cross-Conformal Prediction with label-conditional guarantees is applied, flagging ambiguous cases for clinical review rather than forcing a binary decision. Experiments are conducted on TN5000, a publicly available ultrasound dataset of thyroid nodules. After Spearman correlation filtering, 36 features are retained and the GAM achieves an AUC of $0.89$, a sensitivity of $0.83$, and a specificity of $0.82$ on the validation set. At a significance level $ε=0.09$, selected to ensure empirical coverage guarantees on both classes, 63\% of nodules on the test set receive a certain (i.e., single-label) prediction, with conditional precision of $0.94$ for certain malignant and conditional Negative Predictive Value (NPV) of $0.73$ for certain benign cases, while the remaining 37\% are referred to the clinician.

items.title_en: ECGWmark: Deep Watermarking for Electrocardiogram Signals
items.title_zh: ECGWmark：心电图信号深度水印
items.abstract_en: Secure transmission of electrocardiogram (ECG) signals remains a major challenge in telecardiology. While traditional mathematical watermarking can embed patient metadata directly into ECG signals, it is highly fragile against temporal desynchronization such as circular phase shifts. In contrast, existing deep watermarking approaches for temporal signals, such as audio, typically rely on lossy quantization, which compromises the high-frequency micro-morphological details critical for clinical diagnosis. To bridge this gap, we propose ECGWmark, a fully convolutional and quantization-free deep watermarking framework for medical time-series. ECGWmark operates in a continuous, full-resolution latent space and utilizes a localized frame-level mechanism to improve the robustness to severe desynchronization. Crucially, we introduce a differentiable Physiological Loss guided by a clinical classifier to preserve diagnostic semantics. Experiments on the benchmark MIT-BIH database show that ECGWmark maintains channel-bit extraction accuracy above 90% under the evaluated circular temporal shifts. Furthermore, under a rigorous inter-patient diagnostic evaluation, Class-V sensitivity changes from 71.97% to 76.50%, whereas Macro-F1 changes from 35.25% to 34.71% and Class-S sensitivity from 8.89% to 1.39%; these results indicate mixed class-level effects.

items.title_en: Therapeutic AIBP expression contributes to synaptic preservation and vision restoration against glaucomatous neuroinflammation
items.title_zh: 治疗性 AIBP 表达有助于突触保护与青光眼神经炎症下的视力恢复
items.abstract_en: Lowering intraocular pressure (IOP) is the only approved treatment for glaucoma, yet retinal ganglion cell (RGC) degeneration and vision loss often progress despite reducing IOP. Apolipoprotein A-I binding protein (AIBP) stabilizes ATP-binding cassette subfamily A member 1 (ABCA1) and promotes cholesterol efflux, thus controlling cholesterol-rich lipid rafts and restraining lipid raft-dependent Toll-like receptor 4 (TLR4) inflammatory signaling. Here we show that AAV2-mediated expression of human AIBP (hAIBP) preserves inner retinal synaptic integrity and visual function in experimental glaucoma without altering IOP. In DBA/2J mice, a single intravitreal injection of AAV2-hAIBP at 5 months protected RGCs and preserved pattern electroretinogram and pattern visual evoked potential responses at 10 months, even though IOP was indistinguishable from empty-vector controls. AAV2-hAIBP preserved CaMKII and synapsin phosphorylation, restored synaptophysin and PSD95 in the inner plexiform layer, and reduced the expression of TLR4, complement C1q, IBA1, IL-1b, and IL-6 induction in Muller glia and microglia. Comparable protection was observed in microbead-induced ocular hypertension in C57BL/6 mice, both when the AAV2-hAIBP was delivered before microbead injection and when it was delivered after IOP elevation was established. Elevated IOP reduced endogenous retinal AIBP and ABCA1 expression, and AAV2-hAIBP restored both. Protection required the TLR4-binding domain, as an AIBP mutant lacking this domain failed to preserve RGCs. Conversely, AIBP knockout retinas exhibited increased CaMKII phosphorylation and reduced synaptophysin in the absence of elevated IOP. These findings identify synaptic preservation through the AIBP-TLR4 axis as an IOP-independent therapeutic mechanism and support AAV2-hAIBP as a candidate gene therapy for glaucoma.
items.abstract_zh: 降低眼压（IOP）是青光眼唯一获批的疗法，但即便眼压下降，视网膜神经节细胞（RGC）退变与视力丧失仍常持续进展。载脂蛋白 A-I 结合蛋白（AIBP）可稳定 ABCA1 并促进胆固醇外流，从而调控富含胆固醇的脂筏、抑制脂筏依赖的 TLR4 炎症信号。本研究表明，AAV2 介导的人 AIBP（hAIBP）表达在不改变眼压的情况下，保护实验性青光眼的内层视网膜突触完整性与视功能。在 DBA/2J 小鼠 5 月龄时单次玻璃体腔注射 AAV2-hAIBP，至 10 月龄可保护 RGC 并维持图形视网膜电图与图形视觉诱发电位反应，而眼压与空载体对照无差别。AAV2-hAIBP 维持了 CaMKII 与 synapsin 的磷酸化，恢复内丛状层中 synaptophysin 与 PSD95，并降低 Müller 胶质细胞与小胶质细胞中 TLR4、补体 C1q、IBA1、IL-1b 和 IL-6 的表达。在微珠诱导的 C57BL/6 高眼压模型中，无论递送于微珠注射之前还是眼压升高建立之后，均观察到类似保护。升高的眼压会降低视网膜内源性 AIBP 与 ABCA1，AAV2-hAIBP 可将其恢复。保护作用依赖 TLR4 结合结构域，缺失该结构域的 AIBP 突变体无法保护 RGC；相反，AIBP 敲除视网膜在眼压未升高时即出现 CaMKII 磷酸化升高与 synaptophysin 减少。这些发现确立了经 AIBP–TLR4 轴的突触保护是一种不依赖眼压的治疗机制。
items.highlight_zh: AAV2-hAIBP经AIBP–TLR4轴护突触、救视力，且不依赖降眼压
items.digest_zh:
【研究了什么问题】青光眼目前只能靠降眼压治疗，但许多患者即使眼压控制住，视网膜神经节细胞（RGC）仍在退化、视力继续下降，说明还存在独立于眼压的损伤机制。本文检验能否用基因治疗直接保护突触与视力。
【用了什么方法】AIBP 能稳定 ABCA1、促进胆固醇外流，从而打散富含胆固醇的脂筏、抑制脂筏依赖的 TLR4 炎症信号。作者用 AAV2 载体把人的 AIBP 基因（hAIBP）送入小鼠眼内：在 DBA/2J 遗传性青光眼小鼠 5 月龄时单次玻璃体腔注射；并在微珠诱导高眼压的 C57BL/6 小鼠中分别于升眼压前、后给药。同时用缺失 TLR4 结合结构域的突变体和 AIBP 敲除小鼠做机制对照。
【有什么结果】注射后眼压与空载体对照无差别，但到 10 月龄时 RGC 得到保护，图形视网膜电图与图形视觉诱发电位反应维持；分子层面 CaMKII 与 synapsin 磷酸化被保住，内丛状层 synaptophysin 与 PSD95 恢复，Müller 胶质细胞和小胶质细胞中 TLR4、C1q、IBA1、IL-1b、IL-6 的诱导减少。高眼压本身会降低视网膜内源 AIBP 与 ABCA1，AAV2-hAIBP 可将其恢复；缺失 TLR4 结合域的突变体无效，说明该结构域是保护所必需。
【为何重要】这确立了“经 AIBP–TLR4 轴的突触保护”是一条不依赖眼压的新治疗路径，提示青光眼可在降眼压之外，通过抗炎与保护突触的手段挽救视力。

items.title_en: From Intrinsic Topography to Cognitive Prediction: Benchmarking Approaches to Personalized Cortical Parcellation
items.title_zh: 从内在拓扑到认知预测：个性化皮层分区方法的基准测试
items.abstract_en: Personalized functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) adapts cortical parcellations to individual functional anatomy. Various methods have been proposed that differ in how they combine group-level information, spatial constraints, and individual functional data. Using the Human Connectome Project Young Adult dataset (N = 947), we compared five personalized parcellation methods and a standard group-level atlas. For each method, we calculated functional homogeneity, test-retest reliability, parcel contiguity, and inter-individual Dice overlap. Personalized parcellation methods generally yielded higher functional homogeneity and lower inter-individual Dice than the group atlas, while test-retest reliability of functional connectivity was high across methods. Parcel contiguity differed across methods: some approaches produced almost entirely contiguous parcels, whereas others frequently produced spatially disconnected components, indicating that the detection of candidate ectopic variants depends partly on the parcellation strategy. We also examined whether connectivity and topographic features were associated with and predicted general intelligence (g). Using structural equation modeling, intra-individual parcel size variability and inter-individual parcel size similarity derived from the hierarchical Bayesian method (gMSHBM) were positively associated with g, whereas no corresponding association survived correction for the other methods. Using kernel ridge regression, functional connectivity significantly predicted g, with the group atlas yielding the highest predictive accuracy, consistent with a potential advantage of cross-individual spatial correspondence for edge-wise prediction. Finally, we assessed robustness across four preprocessing pipelines. Although gMSHBM parcellations were not re-estimated, relative between-method patterns in several spatial characteristics were largely preserved. In contrast, brain-behavior associations involving time-series-derived features varied substantially with preprocessing, whereas parcel-size associations were more stable. We conclude that personalized parcellation approaches are associated with distinct trade-offs in spatial correspondence, topographic variability, and downstream predictive utility. The choice of parcellation strategy therefore affects both the properties of individualized maps and the brain-behavior information derived from them.
items.abstract_zh: 个性化功能磁共振成像（fMRI）把皮层分区适配到个体功能解剖。本研究基于人类连接组计划青年成人数据集（N=947），比较了五种个性化分区方法与一个标准群体图谱，评估功能同质性、重测信度、脑区连续性和个体间 Dice 重叠。个性化方法通常功能同质性更高、个体间 Dice 更低，而功能连接的重测信度在各方法间均较高；脑区连续性差异明显，部分方法频繁产生空间上断开的成分。结构方程模型显示，层次贝叶斯方法（gMSHBM）导出的个体内脑区大小变异性与个体间脑区大小相似性与一般智力（g）正相关，其他方法无此关联。核岭回归显示功能连接可显著预测 g，其中群体图谱预测精度最高。研究还在四种预处理流程下检验了稳健性。
items.highlight_zh: 个性化分区同质性更高，但群体图谱预测智力更准
items.digest_zh:
（1）研究问题：每个人的大脑功能区边界并不完全相同，但脑科学研究常套用统一的“群体图谱”来划分皮层。本文要回答：把分区个性化到底有什么收益与代价？哪种方法更可靠？
（2）方法：使用人类连接组计划青年成人数据（N=947），横向比较五种个性化分区方法与一个标准群体图谱，从四个角度打分：同一脑区内功能是否一致（功能同质性）、重复扫描是否稳定（重测信度）、脑区是否连成一片（连续性）、不同人之间脑区是否对齐（Dice 重叠）；并进一步看这些特征能否关联和预测一般智力（g），还换了四种预处理流程检验稳健性。
（3）结果：个性化方法普遍让脑区内功能更一致，但个体间对齐度更低——这正是“个性化”的应有之义。重测信度各方法都不错，但脑区连续性差异很大：有的方法几乎不产生断裂脑区，有的则频繁出现空间上分离的碎片，说明能否检出“异位”脑区变体部分取决于分区策略。与智力的关联上，只有 gMSHBM 导出的脑区大小指标与 g 正相关；而用功能连接预测 g 时，反而是标准群体图谱精度最高。
（4）为何重要：它说明“个性化一定更好”并不成立——个性化有利于刻画个体功能组织，而跨个体的空间对应关系在逐边预测（如预测认知能力）时可能更有价值。这为研究者选择分区策略提供了多维度实证依据。

items.title_en: Neuropeptide Signaling Promotes Stem-Cell Driven Regeneration in Planarians
items.title_zh: 神经肽信号促进涡虫中干细胞驱动的再生
items.abstract_en: Neurons and neuroendocrine cells produce neuropeptides, which act as long-range signals to modulate organismal state and physiological function. In a few cases, neuropeptides have been thought to promote regeneration, but understanding this connection has been difficult due to the relatively poor regenerative capacity of most traditional model organisms. To test whether neuropeptides drive robust regeneration, we used the highly regenerative asexual planarian flatworm as a model. We began by investigating enzymes that cleave and process pre-propeptides to produce bioactive neuropeptides. We characterized 12 putative neuropeptide-processing enzymes and identified three enzymes, prohormone convertase 2 (pc2), carboxypeptidase E (CPE), and peptidylglycine alpha-hydroxylating monooxygenase (PHM-1) that regulate regeneration through their effects on stem cell differentiation and maintenance. We then investigated 51 of the 52 known neuropeptide-encoding genes in planarians, finding that 16 of these genes promote efficient regeneration and/or stem cell function. Our work indicates that diverse neuropeptides regulate endogenous pluripotent stem cells during homeostasis and in robust regeneration. Our data supports a key role for neuropeptide signaling in planarians to promote a pro-regenerative state, which could be valuable to mimic in regenerative therapies.
items.abstract_zh: 神经元和神经内分泌细胞产生神经肽，作为长程信号调节机体状态与生理功能。少数案例提示神经肽可促进再生，但因多数传统模式生物再生能力有限，这一联系难以研究。为检验神经肽是否驱动强健再生，我们以再生能力极强的无性繁殖涡虫为模型。首先研究将前前体肽切割加工为生物活性神经肽的酶：表征了12种候选神经肽加工酶，鉴定出前激素转化酶2（pc2）、羧肽酶E（CPE）和肽酰甘氨酸α-羟化单加氧酶（PHM-1）三种酶，它们通过影响干细胞分化与维持来调控再生。随后我们考察了涡虫52个已知神经肽编码基因中的51个，发现其中16个促进高效再生和/或干细胞功能。本工作表明，多种神经肽在稳态与强健再生中调控内源性多能干细胞，提示神经肽信号可营造促再生状态。
items.highlight_zh: 涡虫中多种神经肽及其加工酶是干细胞再生的关键
items.digest_zh:
（1）研究问题：神经肽是神经元分泌的“远程信号分子”，此前有零星证据提示它们可能参与再生，但大多数经典模式动物（如小鼠）再生能力弱，很难把这条线索查清。
（2）思路与方法：作者选用再生能力极强的无性繁殖涡虫。先从“生产环节”入手——神经肽需由前体肽经酶切加工才具活性，他们表征了12种候选加工酶；再从“产品”入手，系统筛查涡虫已知52个神经肽编码基因中的51个，通过干扰其功能观察再生与干细胞是否受损。
（3）结果：三种加工酶 pc2、CPE 和 PHM-1 缺失会损害再生，机制上影响干细胞的分化与维持；在神经肽基因中，有16个参与保障高效再生和/或干细胞功能。这说明神经肽信号不是个别分子的特例，而是一个成体系的调控网络。
（4）为何重要：它把“神经系统—神经肽—干细胞”串成一条促进再生的通路，说明成体多能干细胞的状态可被神经肽远程调控。若能在哺乳动物中复现类似的“促再生状态”，对再生医学中的组织修复将具有借鉴意义。

items.title_en: Acoustic Context Shapes Cortical Encoding of Spectral Discrimination in Normal and Impaired Hearing
items.title_zh: 声学语境塑造正常与受损听力中频谱辨别的皮层编码
items.abstract_en: The auditory change complex (ACC) provides a cortical measure of acoustic discrimination, yet the mechanisms shaping responses to spectrotemporally complex sounds remain poorly understood. We investigated how acoustic context and temporal-envelope variability influence cortical encoding of spectral contrast in normal-hearing (NH) and hearing-impaired (HI) listeners. Electroencephalography (EEG) was used to record ACCs and auditory steady-state responses (ASSRs) evoked by spectrotemporally modulated stimuli. We compared conventional spectro-temporal modulations (STMs) with a novel discrete spectro-temporal modulation (DSTM) paradigm, examined temporal roving, and evaluated cortical responses to spectral contrast in NH and HI listeners. ACCs elicited by DSTM stimuli were larger and more symmetrical across transition directions than those elicited by conventional STMs. Temporal roving markedly reduced responses to intensity changes while largely preserving responses to spectral changes, indicating a partial dissociation between intensity-driven and spectrally driven cortical discrimination. ACC responses decreased systematically with spectral contrast and were weaker and delayed in HI listeners. By contrast, ASSRs remained highly detectable and showed no systematic dependence on spectral contrast, supporting a distinction between contrast-sensitive cortical discrimination and ongoing envelope encoding. Temporal roving further enhanced separation between NH and HI listeners. ACC response strength was significantly associated with behavioural STM discrimination thresholds and explained variance beyond age and audiometric thresholds. These findings demonstrate that cortical representations of spectral discrimination are shaped by acoustic context and temporal-envelope statistics. Temporal roving attenuates intensity-driven responses while preserving spectrally driven discrimination, providing insight into cortical encoding of spectrotemporal contrast and its relationship to perceptual performance.

items.title_en: 5-HT1A Antagonist WAY-100635 Prevents Chronic Neurodegeneration and Immune Activation After TBI
items.title_zh: 5-HT1A拮抗剂WAY-100635预防TBI后的慢性神经退行性变和免疫激活
items.abstract_en: Traumatic brain injury (TBI) initiates secondary neurodegeneration that compromises interconnected neural circuits and contributes to persistent visual and neurobehavioral impairment. Pharmacological strategies that preserve vulnerable neurons and synapses while limiting chronic neuroinflammation remain an unmet therapeutic need. We previously identified the serotonin 1A receptor (5-HT1A) antagonist WAY-100635 through screening human stem cell-derived retinal ganglion cells (RGCs) and demonstrated that it promotes neuroprotection through cyclic adenosine monophosphate-dependent mitochondrial biogenesis. Here, we investigated whether post-injury treatment extends this neuroprotective efficacy to cerebral and visual circuitry following TBI. Male C57BL/6J mice aged 2-3 months underwent unilateral controlled cortical impact (CCI) involving the left visual cortex. Mice were randomly assigned to sham, untreated injury or treated injury groups, with 3-10 sham controls and 5-8 mice per injury group across experiments. WAY-100635 was administered intraperitoneally at 5 mg/kg daily, beginning 1 hour after injury and continuing for 6 weeks. Therapeutic efficacy was assessed using motor and psychological-health-relevant risk-taking/behavioral disinhibition by elevated-plus-maze assessment, visual electrophysiology, optokinetic responses, diffusion magnetic resonance imaging, and retinal and cortical histopathology. Unilateral cortical injury produced bilateral RGC dysfunction and loss, with greater degeneration in the eye contralateral to the injured hemisphere, consistent with predominantly crossed murine visual projections. WAY-100635 significantly preserved RGC survival and function, improved visual acuity and contrast sensitivity, and preserved visually evoked cortical responses to contralateral eye stimulation. Diffusion MRI revealed bilateral visual pathway abnormalities, with treatment selectively normalizing fractional anisotropy and radial kurtosis in the optic tract ipsilateral to cortical injury. In perilesional cortex, treatment preserved neuronal cell bodies and synapses detected by synaptophysin immunoreactivity while markedly reducing microglial/macrophage activation and reactive astrogliosis. These effects were accompanied by improved early motor performance and attenuation of injury-associated increases in open-arm exploration in the elevated plus maze. Cortical cavity volume was not significantly reduced, supporting preferential protection of vulnerable circuitry surrounding and connected to the primary lesion. These findings identify post-injury WAY-100635 treatment as a novel therapeutic intervention that combines neuronal and synaptic preservation with reduced chronic glial activation and improved functional outcomes. They support further translational development of serotonin 1A receptor antagonism to limit secondary neurodegeneration and the visual and neurobehavioral consequences of TBI.

items.title_en: How aging reshapes implicit learning: behavioral and oscillatory evidence from an EEG-adapted Fast Mapping paradigm.
items.title_zh: 衰老如何重塑内隐学习：来自EEG适配快速映射范式的行为和振荡证据
items.abstract_en: Most of everyday memory formation occurs without deliberate intent, yet the neural mechanisms supporting implicit encoding and their reorganization with age remain poorly understood. The present study investigated age-related changes in implicit learning using an EEG-adapted Fast Mapping paradigm (the Disjunctive Inference Implicit Learning Test, DIILT) in 31 younger and 35 older adults, paired with a comprehensive neuropsychological assessment and a one-month delayed recognition measure. Behaviorally, younger adults rapidly acquired novel implicit associations across the learning phase, whereas older adults showed persistent reliance on familiar items and limited improvement for novel associations. Critically, both groups successfully retained novel associations after one month, with implicitly learned associations showing greater long-term stability than explicitly encoded ones regardless of age. At the neural level, younger adults exhibited early posterior theta engagement for novel compared to familiar items, which disappeared by the end of learning, consistent with novelty-driven associative encoding. Older adults showed no such theta modulation for novel items, pointing to reorganization of the neural mechanisms supporting implicit encoding. Theta dynamics predicted immediate recognition in younger adults but not in older adults who rather showed theta association with processing speed, suggesting an age-related shift from memory-specific binding to domain-general cognitive resource allocation, consistent with neural maintenance frameworks of cognitive aging. These findings demonstrate that implicit encoding produces durable memory traces across the lifespan but relies on reorganized oscillatory dynamics in aging, with implications for understanding how cognitive aging reshapes everyday memory formation.

items.title_en: Fast receptor-antigen dissociation kinetics promote CAR-T cell tumor infiltration, functional fitness, and antitumor efficacy in solid tumors
items.title_zh: 快速的受体-抗原解离动力学促进CAR-T细胞在实体瘤中的肿瘤浸润、功能适应性和抗肿瘤功效
items.abstract_en: Background: CAR-T cells have shown limited efficacy against solid tumors, where they face two major challenges: restricted tumor infiltration and sustained intensive engagement that drive them to exhaustion. Conventional CAR design has largely emphasized high-affinity interactions with slow dissociation, further limiting tumor infiltration and exacerbating exhaustion and dysfunction. We hypothesize that most current CARs are kinetically over-stabilized for solid tumors and that a fast-on/fast-off, cheek-kiss mode of engagement permits transient CAR-antigen disengagement, thereby facilitating tumor infiltration and preserving CAR-T cell fitness in tumor mass. Methods: We identified two monoclonal antibodies targeting the same epitope of epidermal growth factor receptor with comparable kon but distinct koff rates: cetuximab (Cet) and its humanized derivative H1. CAR-T cells incorporating these binders were evaluated in vitro and in vivo. Large, established human tumor xenografts were treated with low-dose CAR-T cells in NSG mice to model conditions of limited T cell availability and sustained tumor antigen exposure. Results: Cet and H1 exhibited comparable kon but markedly different koff rates, with H1 displaying fast-off kinetics with approximately 18-fold shorter binding dwell time. As CARs, H1 showed reduced antigen occupancy and less stable tumor-T cell engagement than Cet. Despite comparable in vitro cytotoxicity, H1 CAR-T cells accumulated more efficiently following tumor stimulation. At high doses, both CAR-T cell products eradicated established tumors. Under low-dose conditions, however, H1 CAR-T cells exhibited superior expansion, persistence, tumor infiltration, and antitumor efficacy, whereas Cet CAR-T cells showed limited expansion and only transient tumor control. Cet CAR-T cells progressively downregulated surface CAR expression, increased PD-1 expression, and exhibited reduced tumor infiltration and impaired functional recovery. In contrast, H1 CAR-T cells preserved surface CAR expression, exhibited greater tumor infiltration, maintained a less exhausted, more central memory-like phenotype, and retained effector function. Conclusion: Fast-on/fast-off binding kinetics enhance CAR-T tumor infiltration, expansion, persistence, and functional fitness, resulting in improved control of established solid tumors. The data provides a rationale for shifting CAR design from affinity optimization toward kinetic optimization to improve the efficacy and safety of CAR-T therapy for solid tumors.

items.title_en: Tissue-resident memory T cells are diminished in the Kaposi sarcoma tumor microenvironment of people living with HIV
items.title_zh: HIV感染者卡波西肉瘤肿瘤微环境中组织驻留记忆T细胞减少
items.abstract_en: Kaposi sarcoma (KS) is a rare neoplasm and an AIDS-defining diagnosis in people living with HIV (PLWH). Although and chronic infection with Kaposi sarcoma-associated herpesvirus (KSHV) contributes to KS progression, the local immune mechanisms that are lost during tumor progression remain incompletely understood. Here, we systematically characterized global patterns in the KS tumor microenvironment (TME) in both PLWH and HIV-negative individuals. Spatial transcriptomics revealed distinct niches comprising of tumor cells, immune cells, and surrounding skin cells. Tumor regions expressed a characteristic endothelial-fibroblastic signature attributable to KS tumor cells (CD34, LYVE1, SCN9A), TME regions expressed marker genes for T cells, B cells and cancer-associated fibroblasts. Analysis of putative cell-cell interactions demonstrated that tumor cells preferentially interact with cells of the TME, including T cells, indicating an important role as hub of cellular communication in KS. Immunofluorescence imaging confirmed increased numbers of T cells, specifically tissue-resident memory T cells (TRM), in KS samples compared to healthy skin, accompanied by a pronounced upregulation of PD-1 expression that was predominantly localized to the TME. Notably, we identified HIV-associated alterations in the KS immune microenvironment: PLWH exhibited loss of CXCR3+ and IFN-gamma producing CD8+ TRM cells in the KS TME compared to HIV-negative patients, a finding consistent with impaired antitumor immunity. Together, our findings reveal HIV-associated disruption of functional anti-tumor immunity in the KS TME of PLWH. Increased PD-1 expression within T cells of the TME highlights potential therapeutic use of immune checkpoint inhibitors in KS.

items.title_en: Unsupervised decomposition of massively parallel TraDIS-Xpress fitness data from Escherichia coli identifies distinct functional and expression modules of antimicrobial resistance determinants
items.title_zh: 对大肠杆菌大规模并行TraDIS-Xpress适应度数据的无监督分解识别出抗菌素耐药决定簇的不同功能和表达模块
items.abstract_en: Linking genotype to phenotype is a central goal in biology, one way to do this is using transposon insertion sequencing (TIS) where the fitness impacts of mutations across a genome are assessed in different conditions. Traditional analyses use comparison of each gene response independently in control versus test conditions, so a compendium of hundreds of test conditions returns hundreds of separate ranked gene lists. To unlock the potential information hidden within large data sets, we applied independent component (ICA) analysis to 754 Escherichia coli BW25113 TraDIS-Xpress samples. These samples included a series of antibiotic and other stress condition exposures. ICA is designed to identify hidden structure within complex data and to extract meaningfully linked components. In this analysis each annotated gene was resolved into a gene body and 198 bp 5' and 3' features so that expression effects driven by the transposon's outwards facing promoter enter the matrix separately from gene disruption effects. The decomposition returned 99 components, which we term fxModules, which were defined as containing elements with similar responses across the whole compendium rather than per any individual experiment. Of the 754 stress samples, the antibiotic arm included 110 samples derived from exposure to 14 separate agents at multiple concentrations. Many of these have been highly studied allowing us to explore the accuracy of predicted responsive fxModules. This analysis showed excellent predictive power of the approach and the fxModules responsive to individual drugs typically reproduced known mechanisms at a resolution superior to analysis of single gene sets. For example, exposure to fosfomycin identified responsive fxModules containing genes which are known to be involved in uptake of the drug, cAMP-CRP control and exposure to gentamicin identified oxidative phosphorylation split across three fxModules responding with different magnitudes and directions at different concentrations. This recapitulates recent work studying the landscape of E. coli genes sensitive to this drug with high precision without any prior knowledge of functional annotation. Similarly precise predictions were made for other drugs. Responsive modules also identified novel groups of genes and linkages beyond the boundaries of defined pathways as being responsive to various stresses demonstrating the ability to predict new genotype-phenotype links. Inclusion of the regulatory regions also resolved fxModules which were entirely contributed by promoter regions, for example for chloramphenicol genes responsible for efflux were identified by signals in intergenic control regions, and unidirectional insertions in gene bodies, a signal that a gene level matrix would not be able to predict with accuracy. These data show that ICA decomposition provides an efficient and accurate annotation independent approach to identifying sets of genes with related functional impacts in any given condition in the compendium. The functional modular association of genes also help in predicting gene functions of unknown genes based on the group function. This approach allows rapid identification of novel genotype-phenotype links and unlocks the power of multiple comparisons of transposon mutagenesis data.

items.title_en: Pulling water from a stone: subaerial biofilm water dynamics on porous solid materials
items.title_zh: 从石头中取水：多孔固体材料上亚气生生物膜的水动力学
items.abstract_en: Subaerial biofilms (SABs) are microbial communities that colonize air exposed surfaces in both natural and engineered environments, forming an interface between the atmosphere and the substrate. Often water availability is crucial for their metabolic activity and survival. While precipitation may contribute to SAB hydration, the dynamic processes of evaporation and condensation - closely linked to fluctuating temperature and humidity conditions - can be key determinants of water availability and they constitute the main focus of this study. We present a model connecting the water-related dynamics in an SAB, its surrounding ambient air and underlying stone/masonry. A central feature of the model is the increased water affinity of the SAB in comparison to the stone pore network. Based on thermodynamic principles, the model captures changes in liquid water content and availability by accounting for the evaporation and condensation at liquid-gas interfaces through gradients in water chemical potential. It accounts for the SAB's capacity to delay water loss by drawing water from substrate material pores to compensate for atmospheric evaporation. The proposed model is compared to prior experimental observations of water transport in limestone samples with and without SAB. Additional numerical simulations under variable environmental conditions demonstrate how permeability of the substrate layer may influence SAB water activity, and how the presence or absence of an SAB might affect water content within stone/masonry.

items.title_en: Ethnic differences in gut microbiota composition and functional capacity persist over six years in the HELIUS multi-ethnic longitudinal cohort
items.title_zh: HELIUS多种族纵向队列中肠道菌群组成和功能能力的种族差异持续六年
items.abstract_en: Background: Ethnic minority groups in Western Europe carry a disproportionate cardiometabolic disease burden not fully explained by conventional risk factors, and their gut microbiomes differ markedly from those of European-origin populations. Whether these differences persist over time has not been examined prospectively. Results: We followed 1,903 participants from six ethnic groups in the HELIUS cohort over 6 years, using faecal 16S rRNA sequencing across all groups and shotgun metagenomics in a matched Dutch and South-Asian Surinamese subset (N = 238 per group). The extent of microbiota compositional change over time differed between ethnic groups: Moroccan participants showed the largest change, while the Dutch and South-Asian Surinamese participants were most stable. Diabetes mellitus and medication use at baseline were associated with greater compositional drift. However, ethnic differences in composition were largely preserved across all six groups (16S: ethnicity R2 0.044 to 0.037; all 15 pairwise contrasts significant at follow-up) and in the shotgun subset (R2 0.047 to 0.037). At the species level, 61 of 78 ethnicity-associated species remained differentially abundant at follow-up. Alistipes putredinis, the species converging most strongly, was absent at baseline in 43% of South-Asian Surinamese participants, and the convergence was consistent with acquisition of this species by this group. At strain level, within-person strain sharing declined with follow-up duration but was similar between ethnic groups. Within hosts, 90% of A. putredinis populations were retained as the same or a closely related lineage, and within the retained subset, microdiversity increased in both groups. Ethnic differences in functional profiles persisted to a similar extent as those in composition, with limited convergence in fibre-degrading enzyme families (GH5_37, GH26). The total antibiotic resistance gene (ARG) burden in the gut microbiome declined similarly in both groups over time. Dutch participants showed higher baseline ARG diversity that converged toward South-Asian Surinamese levels, while class-level differences were predominantly stable. Conclusions: Six years of follow-up in a shared urban environment narrowed ethnic differences in the gut microbiome only modestly; assuming exponential decline, the observed change corresponds to a half-life of roughly two decades.

items.title_en: Distribution and dynamics of Vibrio spp. and pathogen sequences among microhabitats and monsoon seasons in Singapore's coastal waters
items.title_zh: 新加坡沿海水域微生境和季风季节中弧菌属和病原体序列的分布与动态
items.abstract_en: Marine infections are rising in temperate regions due in part to a warming climate. However, comparatively little is known about drivers of marine pathogen dynamics in the tropics where temperatures are high year-round. Vibrio bacteria are ubiquitous in both temperate and tropical marine environments, and many are important pathogens of marine organisms and humans. Here, we sampled an equatorial monsoonal site, the Singapore Strait, over 18 months and applied amplicon sequencing (16s rRNA V6-8 region) to three particle size fractions, qPCR quantitation of Vibrio spp., and generalized linear modelling with environmental variables to understand the factors that structure the Vibrio assemblage. We found that Vibrios represented the highest proportion of pathogen-related DNA sequences, with an assemblage composition influenced by microhabitats (size fractions) and monsoon seasons. Vibrio sequences were dominated by ASVs with highest identity to V. xuii, V. rotiferianus and V. caribbeanicus, and including ASVs matching agents of human disease in Singapore - V. parahaemolyticus, V. alginolyticus, and V. furnissii. Vibrio qPCR abundance was lowest in the largest size fraction (10-150 m), following planktonic DNA trends, even though pathogen-related sequences, including Vibrio, were enriched in this fraction. Temperature was a significant predictor of overall Vibrio abundance, but its effect was no longer significant after adjustment for monsoons, suggesting that the temperature association may reflect broader seasonal dynamics. Instead, effects of chlorophyll, ammonia, nitrate and suspended solids were more consistent within seasons. Furthermore, free-living and particle-associated Vibrios responded differently to environmental changes, suggesting that partitioning into microspatial habitats may lead to differences in their environmental sensitivity.

items.title_en: Circadian phase alignment promotes survival under predictive oxidative stress
items.title_zh: 昼夜节律相位对齐促进预测性氧化应激下的生存
items.abstract_en: Circadian clocks are endogenous time-keeping mechanisms that continue to oscillate with a period that approximates 24 h in the absence of cyclic environmental cues. This free-running period (FRP) varies from species to species and can vary within species across latitudinal clines. Because natural environments provide daily cues that reset circadian clocks to exactly 24 h, the importance of the FRP length is unclear. Using the cyanobacterium Synechococcus elongatus we show that the FRP length alters the alignment of a biological process with an environmental reference, known as phase angle of entrainment, across seasonal photoperiods, thereby repositioning stress response programs relative to the external environment. This phase relationship affects the overall fitness of the organism: strains that position stress-response programs to peak at the time at which the stressor peaks outcompete their early- or late-peaking counterparts. Our results suggest that the FRP length is selected for its ability to adjust the phase angle of entrainment across seasonal photoperiods: the wild-type FRP length was uniquely plastic in its ability to adjust stress-response programs to coincide with the stressor in all photoperiod conditions.

items.title_en: Isoindole-benzohydrazide derivative potentiates colistin activity to overcome resistance conferred by MCR-1 variants in Escherichia coli
items.title_zh: 异吲哚-苯甲酰肼衍生物增强黏菌素活性以克服大肠杆菌中MCR-1变体赋予的耐药性
items.abstract_en: Polymyxin antibiotic resistance mediated by the mobilized colistin resistance (MCR) enzyme threatens the last-resort treatment of deadly multidrug-resistant pathogens, including Acinetobacter baumannii, and calls for urgent mitigation efforts. We used a multifaceted approach involving computational and wet-lab techniques to identify an isoindole-benzohydrazide derivative, JNAL-042, which potentiates colistin activity in an Escherichia coli MCR-resistance phenotype screening model. JNAL-042 lacked intrinsic antibiotic activity but potentiated that of polymyxin antibiotics at 12-24 mug/ml, as demonstrated by bacterial growth susceptibility screens. Cell viability counts and time-kill assays corroborated these findings, demonstrating complete abolition of MCR-mediated resistance by the antibiotic-adjuvant combination at concentrations mirroring those of empty vector controls. Post-induction treatment with this combination similarly prevented the propagation of the resistance phenotype, albeit at a higher antibiotic dose. This landmark study presents JNAL-042 as a promising antibiotic adjuvant to combat MCR-mediated resistance and offers a viable solution to preserve last-resort polymyxin antibiotics.

items.title_en: From dynamic transcripts to stable proteins: multi-omics revealed regulatory buffering of Candidatus Accumulibacter under cyclic conditions
items.title_zh: 从动态转录本到稳定蛋白质：多组学揭示循环条件下Candidatus Accumulibacter的调控缓冲
items.abstract_en: Enhanced biological phosphorus removal (EBPR) relies on polyphosphate-accumulating organisms that experience dynamic fluctuations in redox conditions and substrate availability. How these organisms regulate metabolism across molecular layers under cyclic operation remains incompletely understood. Here, we investigated molecular regulation in a long-term, stable aerobic granular sludge system dominated by Candidatus Accumulibacter. We combined metagenomics, time-resolved metatranscriptomics, and matched metaproteomics across three consecutive operational cycles. Genome-resolved metagenomics revealed an Accumulibacter-dominated community encoding canonical EBPR functions. Time-resolved metatranscriptomics revealed extensive and reproducible transcriptional dynamics affecting hundreds of genes. These dynamics did not align with discrete EBPR phases or instantaneous environmental transitions, but instead unfolded gradually over the cycle. Despite pronounced transcript-level heterogeneity, aggregation at the functional level revealed strong consolidation, with only a limited number of KEGG orthologs exhibiting coherent temporal regulation. Quantitative metaproteomics revealed a stable proteome across EBPR cycles, with no individual proteins or functional categories showing significant differential abundance despite direct transcript-protein mapping and time-matched sampling. This indicated that transcriptional dynamics did not translate into measurable changes in protein pool size on the time scale of individual cycles, consistent with slow, growth-coupled proteome turnover relative to cycle duration. Together, these results support a hierarchical model of regulation in Candidatus Accumulibacter, in which dynamic transcriptional responses are buffered at both the functional and protein levels. This organization provides a plausible basis for stable EBPR performance under predictable cyclic operation and demonstrates how time-resolved multi-omics can be used to resolve regulatory dynamics across molecular layers in engineered microbial ecosystems.

items.title_en: High temperature ligation enables in vitro assembly of eukaryotic genes
items.title_zh: 高温连接实现真核基因的体外组装
items.abstract_en: Our ability to efficiently construct synthetic DNA products is essential to studying and engineering biology. There is an abundance of widely adopted DNA assembly technologies suitable for generating synthetic constructs from diverse DNA inputs, but these techniques suffer from low specificity of connection during assembly, which decreases the accuracy, efficiency, and throughput of construction. Here we propose a broadly applicable paradigm for DNA assembly, High Temperature (HighT) assembly, that lowers misconnection rates by ligating complementary single strand DNA overhangs at reaction temperatures significantly higher than their predicted melting temperatures. By expanding the concept of melting temperature to demarcate smaller association fractions of DNA duplexes, we characterize HighT and demonstrate 40 percentage points increase in accuracy, and 4 orders of magnitude increase in yield of transformants when applying the technique to conventional assembly technologies. HighT is then applied to develop cloning pipelines for the development of efficient assembly-to-integration protocols, the construction of specific low-abundance isoforms of medically relevant proteins from human gDNA and oligos, and the de novo construction of a 10 kb, GC rich genomic region from the functionally extinct Northern White Rhinoceros created entirely in vitro.

items.title_en: Seeded Probes Do Not Identify a Reviewer's Miss Rate: One-Sided Misclassification in Distribution-Free Risk Control
items.title_zh: 种子探针无法识别审稿人的漏报率：无分布风险控制中的单侧误分类
items.abstract_en: Distribution-free risk control certifies that the rate of defects that would change clinical management, among the answers an AI system releases, stays below a stated level, calibrated on cases a human reviewer has checked. The reviewer is an imperfect reference standard whose errors run one way: a missed defect enters calibration as a safe label. This one-sided misclassification lowers the risk on record at every release threshold, so the certificate is anti-conservative by a factor set by the reviewer's miss rate on the system's own defects. We show that seeded probes, which plant known defects and count the catches, do not identify this miss rate. A reviewer's chance of missing a defect depends on how hard that defect is to spot, its detectability. A probe samples defects at detectabilities its designer chose. The system's own defects fall at detectabilities nothing chose, and converting the probe's miss rate into theirs requires the very rate being sought. This holds whenever detectability is not fully captured by an observed score, since a score that captured it would let probes covering its range identify the rate. Cytology field validation builds probe sets whose miss rate is a floor on the true one. Even then the probe bounds the rate from below only, so it can reject a certificate and cannot grant one. The finite-sample label-noise corrections assume noise independent of the case given its label, but a reviewer misses the defects that read as plausible, and the condition they need fails in all four simulated reviewer profiles we examine. Testing that condition on an independent sample takes 185 adjudicated cases for a reviewer missing 85% of defects and 147,938 for one missing 3%. A second reader who adjudicates the cases the careful reviewer passed finds a miss with 95% confidence within 498, so looking for the noise directly costs far less than testing a model of it. Across the 17 physicians who graded at least twenty peer-confirmed defects in a public corpus of model answers, the share they passed varies more than sampling noise explains, with 63% of the variation real and the middle of the true rates spanning 7.5% to 47.9%, too wide to borrow one reviewer's rate for another.

items.title_en: Nulliparity modifies the maternal genetic effects on gestational duration but not on birth weight
items.title_zh: 未产改变母体遗传对妊娠持续时间的影响，但不影响出生体重
items.abstract_en: Gestational duration and birth weight are linked to both short- and long-term adverse health outcomes in mothers and their offspring. Previous genome-wide association studies on these pregnancy outcomes have been successful but have overlooked the number of a mother's previous pregnancies. In this study, we explored if parity (the number of children a mother has previously delivered) modifies the maternal or foetal genetic effect of gestational duration and birth weight (gene x parity interactions) using data from the Norwegian Mother, Father, and Child Cohort Study in up to 58,528 mothers and their offspring. Potential genetic effect differences were investigated by: (1) performing parity-stratified genome-wide association studies, (2) testing SNP x parity interactions, (3) testing the interaction between a polygenic prediction of the traits and parity, and (4) assessing the genetic correlation within each outcome across parity. For both phenotypes, we identified shared and distinct loci for each outcome in terms both of genetic region and number in the parity-stratified genome-wide association studies, and the genetic correlation by parity deviated from one for all outcomes. The strongest evidence of genetic modification effect by parity was found for gestational duration in the maternal genome where genetic effects were stronger in the first pregnancy compared to later pregnancies. For instance, the polygenic prediction of the maternal genome on gestational duration had a significant interaction with parity (p-value interaction = 5 x 10-5). The results for birth weight were more uncertain, suggesting that the identified gene x parity interactions is largely limited to gestational duration. In conclusion, our study reveals that parity modifies the genetic effects on gestational duration and highlights the relevance of considering parity in genetic studies on pregnancy outcomes.

items.title_en: Integrating Causal Inference into Pharmacovigilance: Target Trial Emulations for Proactive Signal Detection of Atorvastatin Initiation in Medicare Beneficiaries
items.abstract_en: Importance: Adverse drug events (ADEs) in older adults are a substantial public health burden, yet spontaneous reporting systems detect them poorly owing to underreporting and the lack of a defined population. These limitations are of particular concern for older adults, who are underrepresented in pre-approval trials yet at elevated ADE risk owing to polypharmacy, multimorbidity, and age-related changes in drug metabolism. Objective: To develop and apply an active, claims-based pharmacovigilance framework using sequential target trial emulation to detect ADE signals in older adults, with atorvastatin as the initial application. Methods: Using Medicare fee-for-service claims (2017-2019), we studied statin-naive beneficiaries aged 65 years or older following hospitalization for myocardial or cerebral infarction. We emulated up to 14 daily sequential trials from the discharge date, classifying patients as initiating atorvastatin (A1), initiating a different medication (A2), or no new medication (A0); the primary contrast was A1 versus A2. For each trial, incident ADEs were ascertained and classified into 552 outcomes based on the Clinical Classifications Software Refined categories. Per-protocol effect estimates were measured over a 6-month follow-up period using Fine-Gray regression weighted by the inverse probability of treatment (IPT) and censoring, treating death as a competing risk, with the false discovery rate controlled via the Benjamini-Hochberg procedure. A signal was declared when the q-value was [≤] 0.10 and the subdistribution hazard ratio (sHR) was [≥] 1.20 in any prespecified analytic stratum (sensitivity analyses used thresholds of q [≤] 0.20 and sHR [≥] 1.20). Results: Of 70,130 eligible patients, 39,948 initiated atorvastatin (A1), 19,182 initiated another new medication (A2); after IPT-weighting, baseline characteristics were closely balanced. After excluding outcomes with sparse cell counts, 295 outcomes were analyzed; five met the primary signal detection criteria: valve disorders (sHR 1.71, 1.20-2.43); sprains and strains (sHR 1.79, 1.26-2.54); general sensation/perception symptoms (sHR 1.23, 95% CI 1.11-1.36); abnormal findings without diagnosis (sHR 1.55, 1.18-2.05); and prediabetes (sHR 1.71, 1.24-2.36). In the sensitivity analysis, we additionally detected: posthemorrhagic anemia, hemorrhagic stroke, varicose veins, other circulatory and skin conditions. Conclusions: A claims-based framework using sequential target trial emulations detected both expected and previously unrecognized ADE signals following atorvastatin initiation in older adults, offering a systematic alternative to passive surveillance that can be extended to other commonly prescribed medications. Confirmatory analyses with disaggregated outcomes and narrower comparators are underway and will be reported separately.

items.title_en: Matched liver-serum multi-omics and genetic risk reveal hepatic compartmentalization of metabolic disease in severe obesity
items.abstract_en: We profiled the hepatic transcriptome, lipidome and metabolome and serum metabolome in 211 MAFALDA participants with severe obesity undergoing bariatric surgery with liver biopsy. In 187 participants with paired samples, liver and serum levels of 40 matched metabolites correlated weakly (median {rho} 0.02), and steatosis and lobular inflammation were associated with 116 and 216 of 701 he-patic but [≤]1 of 653 serum metabolites. Hepatic amino acids were lower with lobular inflammation without serum changes, independently of tissue fat, dilution and glycemia, but largely shared with stea-tosis. Serum added little to clinical discrimination of steatosis (area under the curve 0.73 to 0.75) and nothing for inflammation, steatohepatitis or fibrosis. A polygenic score for hepatic lipid retention was associated with higher hepatic but lower serum triglycerides; its effects on inflammation and steatohepa-titis were largely mediated by liver fat. Circulating metabolites should be validated against histology, not interpreted as direct measures of hepatic metabolism.

items.title_en: Associations between motor and executive/attentional deficits in cerebral palsy: Scoping review
items.abstract_en: Background: Cerebral palsy (CP) is the leading cause of motor disability in children and is frequently accompanied by cognitive impairments, including deficits in executive and attentional functions. Despite growing research on motor-cognitive interactions in other populations, evidence in CP remains limited. Objective: To identify gaps in the current literature, this review synthesised evidence on the relationships between specific motor and executive/attentional functions in CP. Method: A systematic search of three databases was conducted. Articles were screened using predefined eligibility criteria by two independent assessors. The results were summarised in tables and narrative form. The review was written in accordance with the JBI Guidelines. Results: Thirteen articles were included in the review, spanning 652 participants aged between 22 months and 62 years. Five studies reported significant links of motor functions with executive functions, and five with attentional functions. Gross and fine motor skills were most reliably linked to working memory, fine motor skills to overall executive functioning, and gross motor skills to focused attention. Three studies found no evidence of links between motor and cognitive control domains. We include an overview of tools used for measuring motor and attention/executive functions in the reviewed studies. Conclusions: Our review suggests positive associations between motor and executive/attentional functions in individuals with CP, highlighting their interdependence. More longitudinal empirical studies are needed, to confirm these links, which will help design better interventions. Despite the still limited evidence, our findings and anecdotal clinical reports call for intervention studies evaluating the multidimensional, cross-domain functional improvements.

items.title_en: Development and evaluation of a method for classifying foods to be consumed in moderation
items.abstract_en: Background: While the 2020-2025 Dietary Guidelines for Americans (DGA) recommend limiting foods high in added sugars, saturated fat, refined grains, and sodium, they do not provide criteria for classifying foods high in these components. Objective: To develop and evaluate quantitative criteria for classifying moderation foods informed by the DGA. Design: The 2017-2018 Food and Nutrient Database for Dietary Studies (FNDDS, n=6909 foods) was used to evaluate food-level content validity, by examining the proportion of moderation foods within recommended and non-recommended food groups, and convergent validity, by comparing nutrient density in moderation versus non-moderation foods. Dietary recall data from the cross-sectional, nationally representative National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey (2017-2018) were used to assess diet-level convergent validity, by investigating correlations of moderation food intake (% kcal) with overall diet quality. Participants/Setting: Participants in the U.S. aged 2+ years (n=6180) were included. Main outcome measures: The Nutrient Rich Foods 9.3 index (NRF) measured food-level nutrient density; Healthy Eating Index-2020 scores (HEI) measured person-level diet quality. Statistical Analyses: T-tests and ANOVA evaluated differences in nutrient density by moderation food classification. Pearson's correlations estimated associations of moderation food intake (% kcal) with HEI. Results: More non-recommended (e.g., 97% of snacks, 96% of sweets) than recommended (e.g., 19% of vegetables, 23% of fruits) food groups were classified as moderation foods. Mean nutrient density was significantly lower in moderation foods than non-moderation foods (mean difference in NRF scores = -74.8, p<0.001). Moderation food intake (% kcal) was negatively correlated with HEI (r=-0.72), HEI-moderation (r=-0.56), and HEI-adequacy (r=-0.67). Conclusions: The moderation food classification method demonstrated strong content and convergent validity, and may facilitate diet quality assessment, surveillance, and public health interventions.

items.title_en: Developing an OMOP-Standardized Prostate Cancer Database and Improving Data Quality Using NLP and PSA-Based Algorithms
items.abstract_en: Objective: To develop and evaluate an Observational Medical Outcomes Partnership (OMOP) standardized prostate cancer database from the University of Texas Medical Branch (UTMB) Epic Electronic Health Record (EHR) and improve data quality using natural language processing (NLP) and prostate-specific antigen (PSA) based algorithms. Materials and Methods: We built a data pipeline to transform UTMB Epic EHR data from 2010 to 2021 into OMOP Common Data Model (CDM) v5.4. Data quality was assessed by comparing the OMOP-standardized data with Galveston Cancer Registry data using availability agreement, Cohen's kappa, and Intraclass Correlation Coefficient. NLP was used to extract PSA, Gleason score, and cancer stage from clinical text, and PSA-based algorithms were used to identify missing treatment and biochemical recurrence. Results: We extracted 815 analytic cases from UTMB EHR. Among them, 700, or 85.9%, were complete and concordant with the cancer registry. PSA showed excellent value agreement. Structured Gleason score and stage data were sparse, with fewer than 20 cases, but NLP greatly improved capture. Treatment agreement was good compared with the cancer registry and improved slightly for radical prostatectomy after applying a PSA-based algorithm. Using PSA trajectories, we identified 60 cases of biochemical recurrence. Discussion: The OMOP-standardized data from UTMB showed good agreement with the cancer registry. However, structured EHR fields incompletely captured diagnosis, pathology, and treatment details. NLP and PSA-based algorithms substantially improved data capture. Manual review also revealed errors in registry data, showing that OMOP-standardized EHR data can complement and help improve cancer registry quality. Conclusion: OMOP standardization combined with NLP and PSA-based algorithms improved prostate cancer data quality and research readiness.

items.title_en: Deep Learning Trained Without Target-Domain Labels Improves Risk Stratification Over Expert Coronary Calcium Reading on Routine Attenuation Correction CT
items.title_zh: 无需目标域标签训练的深度学习在常规衰减校正CT上优于专家冠状动脉钙化阅片的风险分层
items.abstract_en: Coronary artery calcium (CAC) is an established measure of coronary atherosclerosis on computed tomography (CT). Many SPECT and most PET myocardial perfusion studies already include a low-dose CT scan from which coronary calcium could be reported, yet it almost never is. CAC may not be reported due to image noise, cardiac motion, or the absence of a reliable reference standard. Deep learning (DL) models trained on these low-dose CT scans inherit the same uncertainty, because their reference labels are drawn on the degraded images. We bypassed this limitation by training a DL CAC model entirely outside the target domain: expert labels from high-quality gated CT were inherited by synthetic ungated images derived from those same scans, so that no CTAC scan was annotated, and no real CTAC image was used, at any point in training. Models were trained using one center and externally tested in two other centers. Because each synthetic image is derived from the gated scan itself, expert gated segmentations remain valid voxel-for-voxel without registration. Using these pairs, we developed a cross-domain knowledge adaptation model (knowledge adaptation, KAD-CAC). The DL models were externally tested on 5969 patients with a median age of 64 (IQR 56 - 73), of whom 50.2% were male. The KAD-CAC model had higher Cohens kappa K (0.86, 95% CI 0.84 - 0.88) compared to a convolutional LSTM model (K 0.78, 95% CI 0.76 - 0.80, p<0.01), or models trained with only gated images (K 0.81, 95% CI 0.80 - 0.82, p<0.01). Net reclassification improvement for death or myocardial infarction over a clinical and perfusion baseline was greatest for the KAD-CAC model and exceeded that of expert CAC reading on the same CTAC scans (difference 0.089, 95% CI 0.051 to 0.125, p<0.001). A model trained without any labels from CTAC scans therefore stratified risk of death or MI better than expert reading of the same scans. Patients classified as CAC 0 by KAD-CAC had lower adjusted risk of death or MI than patients classified as CAC 0 by experts (HR 0.50, 95% CI 0.25 - 0.98). We use paired synthetic ungated scans to transfer expert gated CAC annotations into the ungated domain, resulting in better vessel-level CAC scoring and improved risk reclassification compared with expert reading of the same scans. Automated CAC scoring could be added to every myocardial perfusion imaging report without additional imaging or radiation. The approach provides a general route to expert-quality supervision for any acquisition in which the native reference standard is unreliable.
